questions.question: 39. Hepatitis C virus therapy is an evolving field in which 2 drugs were recently approved by Health Canada. Fill the following table. Drug | Mechanism of action | Genotype(s) susceptible to its use; Simeprevir | | ; Sofosbuvir | |

parts.text: Fill the table for Simeprevir and Sofosbuvir: mechanism of action and genotype(s) susceptible

cohort_answer.text: Simeprevir - NS3a/4a inhibitor - Genotype 1. Sofosbuvir - RNA polymerase inhibitor - Genotypes 1,2,3,4. Additional: NS5B=RNA dependent RNA polymerase, Polymerase inhibitors (Sofosbuvir, Dasabuvir); NS5A=Viral replication/assembly, NS5A inhibitors (Daclatasvir, Ledipasvir, Ombitasvir); NS3=Serine Protease, Protease inhibitors (Telaprevir, Boceprevir, Simeprevir, Paritaprevir).

parts.text: What non-serological test will help you determine if treatment is warranted.
HBV table with every drug possible and must name one test required to follow adverse effects.

cohort_answer.text: Non-serological test: Hep B DNA/viral load; ALT. Treatment: First line: tenofovir; Second line: telbivudine or lamivudine; then monitor ALT every 3-6 months following discontinuation of antivirals, if normal and no active disease, just follow up clinically. When started: If HepBeAg negative - for prevention of mother-child transmission, start in 3rd trimester (28-32wks GA) with VL >200,000 regardless of eAg/ALT, can d/c at delivery (only if reason for starting is VL>200,000 and asymptomatic) or 4 weeks post partum; if HBeAg positive, treat same as non-pregnant females. Drug/monitoring table: TDF - Cr and bone density; Entecavir - LFTs; 3TC - lactic acidosis, CBC; Telbivudine - CPK (low barrier to resistance, good for pregnancy); Interferon gamma - TSH (hypothyroid)

questions.question: Table of antivirals for HBV treatment. Name one laboratory test to monitor for each: Adefovir, Tenofovir, Entecavir, Lamivudine, Telbivudine, PEG-INF

parts.text: Name side effects and monitoring test for each drug

cohort_answer.text: Adefovir: SE lactic acidosis/hepatic steatosis, renal exacerbation, hematuria; monitor ALT, Cr, PO4, lactate/CO2, U/A (avoid in HIV+). Tenofovir: SE osteomalacia/Fanconi syndrome; monitor electrolytes/PO4, CrCl. Entecavir: SE lactic acidosis, alopecia; monitor lactate/CO2, kidney function. Lamivudine: SE lactic acidosis/hepatic steatosis, pancreatitis, neutropenia, rhabdomyolysis; monitor ALT, AST, CO2/lactate, CBC, CK. Telbivudine: SE myalgias, steatosis, lactic acidosis; monitor CK, CO2, ALT/AST. PEG-INF: SE elevated ALP/ALT, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, hypothyroidism; monitor CBC, TSH, LFT

parts.text: Hepatitis B Drugs. Name one laboratory monitoring test for each. Given PEG-IFN as an example (TSH). Complete for: Adefovir, Lamivudine, Tenofovir, Telibuvidine, Entecavir.

questions.question: Q25 (2016 PM). Hepatitis B Drugs - Name one lab monitoring test for each. Given PEG-IFN as an example. Drugs: Adefovir, Lamivudine, Tenofovir, Telbivudine, Entecavir

parts.text: Name one lab monitoring test for each drug

cohort_answer.text: PEG-IFN | TSH. Adefovir | Creatinine, lactate. Lamivudine | Amylase (rare pancreatitis). Tenofovir | Creatinine. Telbivudine | CK. Entecavir | Lactate (if clinical concern), transaminases. (Transaminases can be used for all to monitor acute flare.)

parts.text: What 2 drugs are they used with for tx of HCV

cohort_answer.text: MOA: All '-previr' target the NS3/4a serine protease; Boceprevir/Telaprevir inhibit HCV protease by forming reversible covalent bond with NS3 serine active site, preventing proteolytic cleavage of HCV polyprotein into NS4B/NS4A/NS5A/NS5B. Used with: PEG IFN (JAK-STAT immunomodulation) and Ribavirin (inhibits viral polymerase, induces mutagenesis). Genotype: HCV genotype 1 (1b > 1a). (No longer recommended per current guidelines due to newer therapies.)
